note Via barrels in this EM problem are solid: 'Plated Through-Hole' (Fill Plated, 25 µm wall) is built solid. A hollow barrel's air core changes nothing an RF answer can see and meshes into inverted elements; a thermal problem keeps the wall.
note The air box's floor is the underside of 'Bottom Copper (1 oz)' at 0 µm, as a PEC face: it is a drawn ground plane with no hole in it, under all the drawn metal, so nothing below it carries field. State the AirBox's ZMin to pad below it instead.
